visual_species: Pao palembangensis, uninflated humpback-puffer visual study

photos_inspected.license: Reference only; no photograph pixels embedded or redistributed
observations: stout uninflated humpback body with a small beak-like mouth and high eyes
scaleless brown-ochre reticulated skin with subtle dermal microstructure
small posterior dorsal/anal, rounded caudal and no pelvic fins

identification_limits: The generic Freshwater pufferfish entry is interpreted as the Southeast Asian Pao palembangensis in the inspected JJPhoto aquarium image. The normal uninflated form is used; inflation, measured behavior and a Singapore wild-population claim are not delivered.
